title: A protocol to detect apoptotic dendritic cells in murine lymph nodes using multiphoton microscopy
protocol: Sacrifice C57/BL6 mice.
Extract spleens and place them in a Petri dish.
Hold the spleen with tweezers.
Inject PBS/EDTA solution into the spleen until its color becomes clearer.
Place the spleen on a cell strainer.
Pour PBS/EDTA solution over the spleen and strainer.
Use the plunger of a syringe to disaggregate the spleen.
Collect the cellular suspension containing splenic cells.
Centrifuge the collected suspension at 1500 rpm for 10 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the cellular pellet in cold MACS buffer.
Add anti-CD11c Miltenyi magnetic MicroBeads to the resuspended cells.
Incubate the cell-bead mixture for 15 min at 4°C.
Add cold MACS buffer up to a volume of 3 ml.
Equilibrate Miltenyi LS Column by passing 3 ml of MACS buffer through it.
Apply the cell suspension onto the equilibrated LS Column.
Collect unlabeled cells that pass through the column.
Wash the LS Column three times with 3 ml of buffer.
Remove the LS Column from the separator and place it in a new collection tube.
Pipette 5 ml of MACS buffer onto the LS Column.
Flush out the fraction with magnetically labelled cells by applying a plunger.
Add 5 μM of CMFDA to the DCs obtained after elution from the LS Columns.
Incubate for 40 min at 37°C.
Add 2 volumes of cold complete medium to quench staining and incubate 5 min in ice.
Centrifuge twice 5 min at 1000 rpm (201 g) at 4°C.
Collect the pellet and suspend in RPMI at a concentration of 20-40x10^6 DCs/ml.
Inject 50 μl of suspension of DCs in RPMI (1-2x10^6 DCs) along with LPS (1 μg/ml) in each footpad.
Ensure labelled DCs have reached the LN before injecting FLIVO™.
Use a U-100 insulin syringe to inject intravenously 40 μl of stock solution of FLIVO™ (0.2 mg/ml), i.e., with 8 μg of FLIVO.
Inject Red SR-FLIVO™ or Green FAM-FLIVO™ if CMFDA- or SNARF1-labeled DCs were previously injected, respectively.
Sacrifice the animals.
Isolate the PLNs and trim them carefully free of fat under a magnification glass.
Fix the PLNs with paraformaldehyde for at least 30 min.
Immerse the fixed PLNs in PBS.
Cut transversally the PLN along the longest axis using a razor blade.
Prepare an approximately 0.5 mm thick layer composed of two-sided tape.
Perforate a small circular hole in the tape with a diameter large enough to fit the PLN halves.
Deposit the PLN halves carefully into the perforated hole on the tape.
Immerse the PLN halves in fluorescence mounting medium.
Seal the sandwich including the LN pieces with a second glass coverslip, taking care to avoid air bubbles.
Analyze the PLNs under a two-photon microscope using a 20× magnification oil-immersion objective with a 1.20 NA in a Leica confocal inverted microscope.
Optimize two-photon excitation of fluorochromes at 856 nm wavelength.
Detect spectral signals at 510-540 nm for CMFDA and FAM-FLIVO, and at 560-600 nm for SNARF1 and SR-FLIVO.
Configure detector slits to minimize crosstalk between channels.
Thoroughly scan LNs from both sides of the coverslip up to a depth of 200-300 μm with a z spacing of 2 μm.
Examine two-photon microscopy optical section stacks for FLIVO staining using Leica Confocal Software (LCS).
Trace several linear Regions of Interest (ROI) in each cell to be analyzed.
Obtain graphs with the intensity profiles of the SNARF1/FAM-FLIVO or CMFDA/SR-FLIVO pair intensities.
Check for leakage between SR-FLIVO and CMFDA channels.
Measure the Maximum Amplitude of the SR-FLIVO automatically using the LCS.
Subtract the FLIVO channel background value from the measured amplitude.
Analyze apoptotic DCs in the LN using the calculated values.
Calibrate each batch of FLIVO to assess the maximum amplitude limit for non-apoptotic and apoptotic DCs.
Determine the maximum amplitude of the SR-FLIVO channel for non-apoptotic DCs using Hoechst staining.
Consider DCs with a Maximum Amplitude of the SR-FLIVO above 30 as apoptotic.
Re-calibrate FLIVO when changing batches to ensure accuracy.
Measure the values of maximum intensities of SR-FLIVO or calculate the ratio Maximum Amplitude SR-FLIVO over the Maximum Amplitude CMFDA for data representation.
Compare average value of the Maximum Amplitude of FLIVO in control and treated animals to ascertain treatment effects on DC apoptosis.
